name: Playtest 1: your first calls
tip: You're in the Wrestler's corner and he fights on his own: press 4 (Takedown!) when you see a chance, 1 (Pressure!) or 2 (Circle out!) to change how he fights, and once he's on top, 1 again (Ground and pound!) or 2 (Go for the finish!) to send him after a submission. Every call costs voice, so pick your moments.
